assessment: This fundamental study demonstrates that MAPK signaling under heat stress phosphorylates ATF in fission yeast leading to de-repression of the mating type locus. The compelling work shows the phosphorylation of ATF reduces its interactions with the heterochromatin protein Swi6 causes its loss at the mating type locus. This is an example of how signaling regulates transcription factor:co-repressor interactions to control gene expression.
